title: MitraClip NT System Post-marketing Surveillance Study - Japan
brief_summary: The purpose of the MitraClip post-marketing clinical use surveillance study is to observe the frequency, type and degree of adverse device effects and adverse events in order to assure the safety of the new medical device, and to collect safety and efficacy information for evaluating the results of the clinical use.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria: Refer to MitraClip IFU

Exclusion Criteria: Refer to MitraClip IFU
study_population: Post-marketing Surveillance will consecutively register patients with moderate to severe and severe mitral regurgitation (3+ and 4+ MR) in whom a MitraClip implant was attempted.
